paragraphs: R. Niḥa bar Sava. R. Yoḥanan in R. Zeira's name, Jerusalem Talmud, beginning of the last chapter of Kilayim. He asked R. Yonah, Jerusalem Talmud, beginning of Yesh Muttarot. R. Yonah in R. Hamnuna's name, Jerusalem Talmud, end of HaArel.
